entries.zh: 察觉、领悟；留意（次要义：提醒、告诫）
entries.en: to notice, to realize; to take heed (secondary: to warn, to advise)

entries.zh: 我已领悟了；简短地察觉、提醒
entries.en: I have noticed/realized; to notice briefly (to warn briefly)
entries.notes: L 栏含第一人称『aduertido yo』与缩写 breuem.te，H 栏「悟了」只对应前半。

entries.zh: 煽动、撺掇；以言辞奉承讨好
entries.en: to flatter, to coax; (lit.) to fan, to incite
entries.notes: 「煽」本义扇火鼓动，与 adular（奉承）为引申对当；M 栏附注 [pên cheh.] 未解。

entries.zh: 煽惑；用甘言奉承以诱人上当
entries.en: to incite and delude; to flatter in order to deceive

entries.zh: 用言语煽诱、哄骗
entries.en: to coax with words; to wheedle in order to deceive
entries.notes: H 栏为「口+扇」罕用异体字，义据 L 栏与同组「煽」系字推定。

entries.zh: 谄谀、奉承（以骗取信任）
entries.en: to flatter, to adulate (in order to deceive)

entries.zh: 谄媚奉承、阿谀讨好
entries.en: to flatter and fawn; to adulate

entries.zh: 谄媚；当面奉承而背后诋毁
entries.en: to flatter (and afterwards speak ill behind one's back)

entries.zh: 谄谀奉承，随后背后议论诋毁
entries.en: to flatter and adulate, then backbite
entries.notes: M 栏作 tiámᶜ mŷ xù 三音节，而 H 栏仅「諂諛」二字，对音切分待考。

entries.zh: 谄媚讨好；背后说人坏话
entries.en: to flatter, to fawn (and then gossip about someone)

entries.zh: 谄媚他、巴结讨好（伊＝他/她）
entries.en: to flatter him/her; to fawn on someone
entries.notes: 「諂伊」非经典复合词，伊为第三人称代词，义据 L 栏与前后条推定。

entries.zh: 嘴甜、能说会道（且爱以言辞讨好）
entries.en: glib, smooth-tongued; talkative and given to flattery
entries.notes: 「好口」为口语拼合（M 读 hò chuỳ，即好嘴），非经籍成词，义据 L 栏推定。

entries.zh: 冷言冷语；以反话讽刺地奉承
entries.en: cold, ironic words; to flatter ironically

entries.zh: 冷语、讥讽之辞；说反话讨好
entries.en: sarcastic remarks; ironic flattery

entries.zh: 假装附和以奉承；顺着别人的心意说话
entries.en: to flatter by feigning agreement; to follow another's will
entries.notes: H「同人口」为口语拼合（M tâng lāng chuỳ，同人嘴），义据 L 栏『yrse tras la voluntad del otro』推定。

entries.zh: 藏口不言，隐讳他人过失以讨好
entries.en: to keep silent about someone's faults (to curry favor); lit. to hide the mouth
entries.notes: 「藏口」为口语说法（M quêng chuỳ，藏嘴），非经典成词，义据 L 栏推定。

entries.zh: 以甘言寄食的谄媚之徒；口腹之徒
entries.en: a parasite/sycophant who lives by flattering words
entries.notes: L「adulador, q. caricias」与 H「口腹」字面不合，M 栏附注 [mat peem.] 未解，释义存疑。

entries.zh: 奸夫；通奸的男子
entries.en: adulterer (male)
entries.notes: H「路人」字面为「过路之人」，与「奸夫」不合，当属俗称或婉称，语义链路待考。

entries.zh: 奸夫；在外勾搭女子的男子
entries.en: adulterer; a man who consorts with women outside his household
entries.notes: H「路頭翁」字面为「路口老翁」，作「奸夫」解当属俗称，语义链路待考。

entries.zh: 淫妇；通奸的女子
entries.en: adulteress; a woman guilty of adultery
entries.notes: H「失郎」字面「失去丈夫」与「淫妇」义隔一层，且 M 栏 chiêr 与「郎」对音不合，疑有讹字。
